title: No additional research
design_rationale: Existing information and same feasible actions

title: Better lawful-consumption records
design_rationale: Matched period/catchment/product evidence with stocks and lawful unrecorded supply

title: Survey and product-mix enhancement
design_rationale: Independent age/use/product evidence; no direct linkage to identifiable individuals

title: Anabasine only
design_rationale: Tobacco-related exposure with yield and non-combustible cross-signal uncertainty

title: Cotinine only
design_rationale: Nicotine exposure across tobacco/vapes/NRT/pouches; not tobacco origin

title: Cotinine plus 3-hydroxycotinine
design_rationale: Correlated nicotine metabolites, shared dose/calibration, analyte fractions distinguished

title: Three-analyte panel
design_rationale: Estimate incremental value of 3HC, not automatic inclusion

title: Two-analyte panel plus lawful consumption
design_rationale: Joint inference; no biomarker of legal origin

title: Three-analyte panel, supply and survey
design_rationale: Combined exposure, supply and independent subgroup evidence

title: Calibration research
design_rationale: Yield, product background, sewer recovery and laboratory calibration designs

title: Calibration plus panel and supply
design_rationale: Value complementary information jointly rather than summing EVSI

title: Staged calibration then selected surveillance
design_rationale: Stop/adapt/purchase second stage using existing sequential reference; site-time model remains open

title: Causal policy-effect evidence
design_rationale: Independent designed evaluation/credible causal evidence, not learned from baseline assays

title: Panel, supply and causal-effect evidence
design_rationale: Joint action-relevant evidence; effect study feasibility and cost unresolved
